# Growth Lead, PIMS
## Location
Remote 
## Employment Type
Full time
## Location Type
Remote
## Department
Growth and Marketing
[Overview](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Vetcove/e2da3294-4718-481f-822f-a6a5de7ee6c3)[Application](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Vetcove/e2da3294-4718-481f-822f-a6a5de7ee6c3/application)
Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.
We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.
We are looking for a **Growth Lead, PIMS** to own how veterinary clinics use Vetcove’s PIMS-powered customer relationship management tools to grow their business. This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing strategy, and AI-driven systems, with a focus on helping clinics unlock revenue through scalable, automated customer journeys. You will define how our AI-powered marketing journeys should work, what guardrails are required, and how clinics can drive outsized growth without adding operational burden.
Rather than building one-off campaigns, this role is responsible for designing the playbooks, experimentation frameworks, and growth loops that power a clinic’s AI-driven marketing experiences. You will deeply understand the pet parent voice, apply traditional lifecycle and email marketing principles as inspiration, and then push beyond them using AI, automation, and creative growth hacks. You will partner closely with Product to shape features that enable clinics to increase retention, upsell services, and grow client revenue in ways that have not been possible in veterinary software before.
**What you’ll do**
  * Work closely with product, design, and engineering to define AI-powered marketing capabilities and infrastructure within the Vetcove PIMS
  * Own the strategy for AI-driven marketing journeys, including experimentation frameworks, messaging guardrails, personalization logic, and automation rules
  * Design and maintain scalable marketing playbooks that enable rapid iteration and growth without hard-coded content
  * Continuously identify and test growth hacks that clinics can leverage to increase engagement, retention, upsell, and ARPC
  * Translate proven email and lifecycle marketing strategies into AI-enabled systems that learn and improve over time
  * Serve as the internal expert on pet parent psychology, messaging, and behavioral triggers
  * Partner with Product to ideate, prototype, and validate new features that unlock novel growth opportunities for clinics
  * Use data and experimentation to refine journeys, playbooks, and AI guardrails based on real-world performance
  * Advocate for scalable, low-effort growth mechanisms that clinics can benefit from automatically
  * Create clear guidance, examples, and best practices to drive internal alignment and clinic adoption of AI marketing tools


**You should have:**
  * 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, or a related role
  * Expertise prompt engineering AI systems to produce consistent, reliable results.
  * Hands-on experience designing or operating AI-driven, automated, or rules-based marketing systems
  * Strong understanding of email marketing, customer journeys, and experimentation methodologies
  * A track record of identifying and executing creative growth hacks that drive measurable business impact
  * Comfort partnering deeply with product and engineering teams on systems, tooling, and infrastructure
  * Ability to design flexible frameworks and guardrails rather than one-off campaigns
  * Strong intuition for consumer voice and persuasive messaging, especially in trust-based or service-oriented industries
  * Data-informed but creatively driven, with a bias toward testing, learning, and iteration
  * Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence without direct authority
  * Self-motivated, adaptable, and energized by building new growth engines from scratch


**Benefits (Full Time Roles)**
  * 100% remote within the USA
  * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  * Automatic 401k contribution
  * Employee referral program
  * At home office set up
  * Bi-annual company retreats
  * Open vacation policy
  * Equity
  * Monthly team events


The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $95,000/year - $160,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. **There is a different range applicable to specific work locations.** For Colorado, the salary range is: $95,000 - $120,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives.
  
In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits  
package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more  
details.
To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is October 1, 2026.
Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time. 
**Attention all job seekers!** We want to ensure that you’re well-informed about a serious matter affecting the job market. It has come to our attention that scammers are operating in the industry, impersonating employees and attempting to deceive savvy applicants like you. Here’s what you need to know:
  1. Our job listings are exclusively available on official sites (our careers page, LinkedIn, BuiltIn, and Indeed). Be cautious of other sources claiming to represent us or any organization that you’re interested in. Stay on the lookout!
  2. Authentic communications from our company will only come through verified email addresses and phone numbers. If you receive unexpected messages or calls, exercise caution and verify their authenticity. Don’t let scammers catch you off guard!
  3. It's essential to independently verify the legitimacy of any job postings you come across. Visit our official careers page to confirm the validity of any openings. Stay proactive and protect yourself!
  4. Remember that during the application process, we will _**never**_ request sensitive personal or financial information from you. Be wary of anyone asking for such information. Keep your personal data secure!
  5. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or encounter suspicious individuals, please report it immediately to our recruiting department. By working together, we can combat these scams and keep the job market safer for everyone.


We understand the importance of your job search and want to ensure your experience is positive and secure. Always exercise caution and stay scam-smart!
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.
Vetcove is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know and we will make every effort to accommodate your needs.

The Associate Account Manager Role for Vetcove’s Brand Partnerships team provides support to help maintain relationships with our largest partners. This is accomplished through providing marketing campaign expertise and skillful project management in order to deliver above and beyond customer service. This is an outstanding opportunity to build and manage key client relationships, be a platform and product expert, and act as our partners’ go-to for all aspects related to the campaign lifecycle. 
This role will report to a Senior Account Manager and primarily focus on supporting the Senior Account Manager in covering Vetcove’s biggest partners. The ideal candidate is an analytical and detail-oriented individual with the capacity and desire to succeed in a high growth environment. They have a strong ability to successfully collaborate with others, and thrive in a client facing role.

  * Collaborate with the Senior Partner Account Manager on recurring client tasks

  * Work collaboratively with data scientists and other account managers to craft narratives and prove customer value through comprehensive business reviews and strategic touch-points, both over the phone and through on-site meetings
  * Educate and guide new and existing clients on best practices, on-board new clients and proactively address areas where improvement is needed
  * Nurture relationships to be sure they understand Vetcove’s value and how we can fit into long term strategy

  * 1+ Years in account management
  * Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills
  * Excellent time and process management skills
  * Strong analytical skills 
  * Experience in developing client facing reports with actionable insights and recommendations

  * Experienced in compiling, documenting and communicating client requirements to internal stakeholders (e.g., Finance, C-Suite, Engineering)
  * Strong working knowledge of entire Microsoft Office suite, with an emphasis on PowerPoint and Excel
  * Experience in Tableau or other database visualization tools La plus but not required 
  * Interest in client relationship building and willingness to travel for client-facing events 
  * A strong desire to learn and define an emerging function in a rapidly growing and dynamic startup environment

  * 100% remote within the USA
